title: Master Bedroom Restoration
summary: Two distinct restoration passes kept the original floor, board walls and ceiling, tall windows, trim, and built-in cabinet at the center of the room.
searchSummary: Master bedroom preservation across separate 2023 and 2024 passes, with surface renewal, protected finish work, limited electrical investigation, and return to use.
recorded: March 22–August 5, 2023, and July 6–August 11, 2024, in the source journal.
sourceLabel: Master bedroom restoration journal and two Home Reno - Master Bedroom Flickr albums

gallery.caption: After the second pass, the room returned to use with the renewed board surfaces and retained floor, windows, trim, and built-in cabinet.
The finished wood floor was protected while the 2024 refinement work continued above it.
An opened older electrical box records a limited investigation during the first restoration pass.

introduction: The bedroom work happened in two separate passes. The first renewed a worn room without discarding its original fabric; the second refined the surfaces and finish while protecting what the first pass had already recovered.
evidenceBoundary: The archive records an opened electrical box and later outlet testing. It does not establish full circuit replacement, inspection, or code compliance.
